note: Real Deal Seal demonstration rules. They are this project's published policy, not PayPal merchant criteria. Each business type is judged only on evidence that applies to it.

business_types.label: Physical goods
business_types.examples: linen shops, garden stores, clothing sellers

rules.label: At least 30 completed orders over 60 days
Tracking on 90%+ of recent shipped orders
80%+ of recent orders shipped within 2 days
Disputes lost on 2% or fewer of recent orders
Refunds on 8% or fewer of recent orders
At least 30 paid jobs over 60 days
90%+ of recent paid jobs completed
rules.short: paid jobs are often not completed

rules.label: The business cancelled 10% or fewer of recent jobs
Disputes lost on 2% or fewer of recent jobs
Refunds on 8% or fewer of recent jobs
At least 30 completed sales over 60 days
Disputes lost on 2% or fewer of recent sales
Refunds on 8% or fewer of recent sales

metrics.label: Completed orders
metrics.definition: Orders with a completed payment, all history.

metrics.label: Net sales
metrics.definition: Captured minus refunded, all history, whole US dollars.

metrics.label: Selling for
metrics.definition: Days from the first completed order to the assessment date.

metrics.label: Orders refunded
metrics.definition: Recent orders with any refund / recent orders.

metrics.label: Buyer disputes lost
metrics.definition: Recent orders with a dispute decided for the buyer / recent orders.

metrics.label: Orders from returning buyers
metrics.definition: Recent orders from a buyer key seen before at this shop / recent orders.

metrics.label: Shipped orders with tracking
metrics.definition: Recent shipped orders with a tracking number on record / recent shipped orders.

metrics.label: Shipped within 2 days
metrics.definition: Recent shipped orders that left within 2 days of payment / recent shipped orders.

metrics.label: Paid jobs completed
metrics.definition: Recent paid jobs with a completion or kept-booking record / recent paid jobs.

metrics.label: Jobs cancelled by the business
metrics.definition: Recent paid jobs the business cancelled / recent paid jobs.

metrics.label: Sales delivered
metrics.definition: Recent sales with a delivery record / recent sales.

metrics.label: Payments confirmed by PayPal records
metrics.definition: Recent orders whose payment was read back from PayPal / recent orders. The rest are the business's own imported records.

evidence_classes.meaning: Read back from PayPal's own records in the PayPal sandbox (test environment).
Supplied by the business (a tracking number, a completion record or an imported file). Not independently confirmed.
Simulated for the demo. The sandbox cannot backdate orders or let a shop open buyer disputes.
No records to measure yet. Never treated as zero problems.

source_systems.description: Orders read back by ID from the PayPal sandbox Orders v2 API.
Orders created and captured through this app's PayPal checkout, confirmed with PayPal server-side.
Orders imported from a file the business supplied. Labelled as reported until confirmed.
